announcements.title: Welcome to BetterTrumpet 3.3
announcements.body:
This page is how we talk to you between releases. A few things to know:

• You can turn it off at any time in Settings → Privacy. No messages, no badge.
• It reads directly from the BetterTrumpet API — the same anonymous channel used by everything that leaves the app.
• Everything here is anonymous. The only exception is manual log export, which you trigger yourself when debugging (Settings → About → Diagnostics).

Expect updates about the app on this page, and from time to time we will ask for your opinion on features and design.

announcements.title: What should BetterTrumpet's priority be?
announcements.body: One vote per installation. Pick the one that matters most to you.

announcements.title: If there is one feature I would add, it would be:
announcements.body: No right or wrong answer. Your reply goes straight to the BetterTrumpet API, anonymously.
